paracetamol.label_usually_says: Commonly taken for fever and mild to moderate pain relief. Typical adult guidance is up to 650mg every 4 to 6 hours as needed, not exceeding 4000mg (4 grams) in 24 hours.
paracetamol.timing: After meals or with plenty of water
paracetamol.common_warnings: Do not exceed maximum daily dose to prevent liver injury. Avoid taking multiple medicines containing paracetamol simultaneously.

dolo.label_usually_says: Widely prescribed for high fever and body ache. Commonly taken 1 tablet 2-3 times daily after food as advised by a physician.
dolo.common_warnings: Do not take more than 4 tablets in 24 hours. Avoid alcohol while taking.
dolo.purpose: Controls fever and severe body pain

azithromycin.label_usually_says: Broad-spectrum macrolide antibiotic. Commonly prescribed as a once-daily dose for 3 to 5 consecutive days. Complete the full course even if symptoms improve.
azithromycin.timing: Preferably 1 hour before or 2 hours after food, at the same fixed time daily
azithromycin.common_warnings: Do not stop midway. May cause mild nausea or loose stools. Antacids containing aluminum or magnesium may reduce absorption.
azithromycin.purpose: Antibiotic for respiratory and throat infections

amoxicillin.label_usually_says: Penicillin-class antibiotic. Prescribed for bacterial infections of throat, chest, ear, and urinary tract. Often taken 2 to 3 times a day.
amoxicillin.timing: At the start of a meal to reduce stomach discomfort
amoxicillin.common_warnings: Contraindicated if you have a known penicillin allergy. Finish the full prescribed duration.

pantoprazole.label_usually_says: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that suppresses stomach acid production. Used for GERD, acid reflux, heartburn, and stomach protection alongside antibiotics or painkillers.
pantoprazole.timing: First thing in the morning on an empty stomach (30-60 minutes before breakfast)
pantoprazole.common_warnings: Swallow whole with water; do not crush or chew. Long-term use without physician guidance is not advised.
pantoprazole.purpose: Reduces stomach acidity and prevents gastritis

cetirizine.label_usually_says: Antihistamine used for allergy symptoms like sneezing, runny nose, watery eyes, itching, and hives. Often taken once daily.
cetirizine.timing: At bedtime, with or without food
cetirizine.common_warnings: May cause drowsiness or dizziness. Avoid driving or operating machinery and avoid alcohol.
cetirizine.purpose: Relieves sneezing, runny nose, and allergies

metformin.label_usually_says: First-line oral anti-diabetic medication for type 2 diabetes. Helps the body utilize insulin better and reduces glucose production in the liver.
metformin.timing: With or immediately after meals (breakfast and/or dinner)
metformin.common_warnings: Never skip meals when taking diabetes medication. Watch for signs of low blood sugar. Avoid heavy alcohol intake.
metformin.purpose: Regulates blood sugar levels for diabetes

amlodipine.label_usually_says: Calcium channel blocker for high blood pressure (hypertension) and chest pain (angina). Relaxes blood vessels to improve blood flow.
amlodipine.timing: Once daily at the same time every day, morning or night
amlodipine.common_warnings: Do not stop abruptly without doctor approval. May cause mild ankle swelling or headache.
amlodipine.purpose: Lowers blood pressure and protects heart

ibuprofen.generic_name: Ibuprofen (often combined with Paracetamol in Combiflam)
ibuprofen.label_usually_says: NSAID non-steroidal anti-inflammatory pain reliever. Reduces inflammation, swelling, toothache, joint pain, and fever.
ibuprofen.timing: Always after meals or with milk to protect stomach lining
ibuprofen.common_warnings: Can irritate stomach lining. Not recommended for patients with stomach ulcers, kidney disease, or in late pregnancy.
ibuprofen.purpose: Relieves inflammatory body pain, toothache, and swelling

ors.label_usually_says: Replaces essential fluids and electrolytes lost during diarrhea, vomiting, or heavy sweating from heat exhaustion.
ors.timing: Sip frequently throughout the day after each loose motion or episode of sweating
ors.common_warnings: Dissolve the entire sachet in exactly the recommended quantity of clean drinking water (usually 1 liter). Do not boil prepared solution; discard after 24 hours.
ors.purpose: Restores hydration and essential body salts

montelukast.label_usually_says: Combination leukotriene receptor antagonist and antihistamine for allergic rhinitis, asthma symptoms, and chronic cough.
montelukast.timing: Once daily at night before sleeping
montelukast.common_warnings: May induce mild drowsiness. Inform doctor if unusual mood changes or agitation occur.
montelukast.purpose: Calms allergic cough, wheezing, and congestion

telmisartan.label_usually_says: Angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) used to manage hypertension and reduce cardiovascular risk.
telmisartan.timing: Once daily at the same time, with or without food
telmisartan.common_warnings: Contraindicated in pregnancy. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function recommended.
telmisartan.purpose: Controls blood pressure and guards kidney health

atorvastatin.label_usually_says: Statin medication used to lower bad cholesterol (LDL) and triglycerides and reduce the risk of heart attacks and strokes.
atorvastatin.timing: Once daily at night, with or without food
atorvastatin.common_warnings: Report unexplained muscle pain or tenderness immediately. Avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice.
atorvastatin.purpose: Lowers cholesterol and prevents artery clogging

ofloxacin.label_usually_says: Dual antibacterial and antiprotozoal combination commonly prescribed for gastrointestinal infections, stomach bugs, and loose motions.
ofloxacin.timing: Twice daily after meals for usually 3-5 days
ofloxacin.common_warnings: Strictly avoid alcohol during treatment and for 48 hours after to prevent severe nausea/headaches. Complete the full course.
ofloxacin.purpose: Treats bacterial stomach infections and diarrhea

domperidone.label_usually_says: Prokinetic and anti-emetic used to prevent nausea, vomiting, indigestion, and bloating.
domperidone.common_warnings: Take for the shortest necessary duration. Consult doctor if heart rhythm irregularities exist.
domperidone.purpose: Stops nausea, vomiting, and feeling full

ranitidine.label_usually_says: Reduces excess stomach acid secretion to treat indigestion, acid indigestion, and peptic ulcers.
ranitidine.timing: 30 minutes before meals or at bedtime
ranitidine.common_warnings: Inform doctor if stomach symptoms persist beyond 2 weeks.
ranitidine.purpose: Soothes acid reflux and stomach burn

levothyroxine.label_usually_says: Synthetic thyroid hormone to treat hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid gland).
levothyroxine.timing: Strictly first thing in morning with plain water, 45-60 minutes before tea/coffee or breakfast
levothyroxine.common_warnings: Do not take calcium or iron supplements within 4 hours. Requires regular TSH blood tests to adjust dose.

diclofenac.label_usually_says: Potent anti-inflammatory pain medicine for severe joint pain, arthritis, dental surgery, and muscular strains.
diclofenac.timing: Always with or after meals with plenty of water
diclofenac.common_warnings: Short-term use only. High risk of gastrointestinal irritation. Use with caution in hypertension and cardiac conditions.
diclofenac.purpose: Relieves acute arthritis and muscular joint pain

vitamin_d3.label_usually_says: High-dose Vitamin D3 to correct deficiency, support bone density, and enhance calcium absorption.
vitamin_d3.timing: Once a week after the main meal containing some dietary fat or with milk
vitamin_d3.common_warnings: This is a weekly dose, NOT daily! Do not take daily unless specifically instructed by a doctor.

cough_syrup.label_usually_says: Provides symptomatic relief from persistent cough, chest congestion, or dry throat tickle.
cough_syrup.timing: After meals, using the supplied measuring cup
cough_syrup.common_warnings: May cause drowsiness. Check whether formula is for dry cough or wet chesty cough.
cough_syrup.purpose: Soothes coughing and loosens chest mucus

interactions.warning: Combining multiple pain/fever medicines (e.g. Brufen and Crocin/Dolo) increases risk of stomach upset and liver/kidney strain. Verify if a combined formulation like Combiflam is already prescribed.
Amoxicillin may decrease clearance of methotrexate, increasing toxicity.
Drinking alcohol while taking Metformin increases the risk of lactic acidosis and severe hypoglycemia.
Pantoprazole suppresses stomach acid which may alter the absorption rate of azithromycin. Take pantoprazole 30-60 mins before food and azithromycin 1 hour before or 2 hours after food.
Often prescribed together for hypertension. Monitor for lightheadedness or excessive low blood pressure when standing.
Two NSAIDs should NOT be taken simultaneously. Doing so multiplies the danger of stomach ulcers, bleeding, and kidney impairment.
Calcium, iron, and antacids bind to thyroxine and prevent its absorption. Keep a strict 4-hour gap between them.

generic_schemes.jan_aushadhi_note: Under the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP), high-quality generic equivalents are available at Jan Aushadhi Kendras across India at up to 50%-90% lower prices than branded medicines.
